status: pre-scoring protocol; public commit required before new chart calculations
questions: Do new source birth-year cohorts differ from a fixed 2006 reference in defined structural quantities?
Can the analysis recover prespecified injected synthetic effects while controlling error under declared simulation mechanisms?
data_seen_before_freeze: R8 results were already public. New-source catalogue/schema and birth-field quality audits may be inspected; no new cohort chart scores or external outcomes have been inspected.

engines.policy: Reuse frozen R8 scoring engines unchanged for comparability; traditional interpretation gaps retained and audited, not silently fixed

reference.reference_uncertainty: Fixed empirical reference conditional estimand; ordinary target resampling excludes reference-estimation uncertainty

source_slots.status_at_freeze: both lack HORANASC; unavailable; no further substitution

source_slots.coverage_limitation: 2015 births registered during2015 only; delayed registrations outside archive absent; not all2015 Mexican births; source-frame weights do not repair this selection

sampling.if_frame_smaller: census; do not top up from another birth year
sampling.strata: state of birth x explicit M/F source sex, within fixed source/birth year
sampling.quota_algorithm: 1 per nonempty stratum, then floor((n-H)*(N_h-1)/(N-H)), remaining by descending exact fractional remainder and ascending stratum string ties
sampling.ranking: ascending SHA256(OBS-R9-2026-11-27|source_id); physical source ordinal identifies records; no result-based selection
sampling.geo: explicit official locality or municipal-seat reference coordinates; record approximation; unresolved historical time zones excluded
sampling.weights: N_h/n_h within final eligible source frame only

age_window.definition: same R8 July1 completed civil-age indexing; 40 points; calendar plot2026–2070 includes eligible years only

fixed_reference_transform.formula: For each system/band, F_R(x) = sum_i w_i sum_a [1(score_ia<x)+0.5*1(score_ia=x)]/(10*sum_i w_i); apply without refitting target
fixed_reference_transform.ties: weighted mid-CDF; threshold does not guarantee20% positive years

primary_endpoint.J: source-weighted proportion of record-years with at least3 of4 fixed-reference transformed scores>=0.8

secondary_endpoints: four raw-score means and differences from fixed reference
DeltaL=weighted mean across40ages and4fixed-reference percentiles minus0.5
R8 within-person relative alignment output, separately labelled continuity analysis
calendar curves descriptive only; no unregistered peak significance tests

inference.real_source_contrasts: no cross-cohort exchangeability or AI-null p-value claimed
inference.conditional_sampling_interval: whole-record resampling within source strata; fixed reference; state limitations and sparse strata; never resample40annual points as independent subjects
inference.simulations: explicit synthetic DGP only; report false positive rates, control-effect recovery and Monte Carlo uncertainty
inference.equivalence: not inferred from nonsignificance; no claim of excluding all structural differences
inference.AI_causality: no bridge from these quantities to AI civilizational effects

input/schema/hash checks and deterministic positive/negative controls before real scoring
calibration power limitations reported; no sample-size increases selected after observing real effects
selected birth inputs and scoring code hashes sealed before execution
iteration_policy: All deviations, fixes and new rules recorded additively; preserve R8 and this original protocol; published freeze is not independent external peer review
ai_track: Separate observed-evidence ledger; no astrology/AI composite score or probabilities
